g.text: Deterministic Browser Telemetry & Static Codebase Correlation Loop
TELEMETRY CONSOLE // ACTIVE STAGE INSPECTOR DOCK
MEASURE — Runs Lighthouse and captures browser performance measurements.
Executes headless Chrome under controlled laboratory conditions, simulating calibrated mobile (4G throttling) and desktop profiles without external network contamination.
INPUT: Target URL + Device Profile (Mobile / Desktop)
OUTPUT: Raw Lighthouse LHR JSON · INVARIANT: Empirical facts only, zero speculation
EVIDENCE — Normalizes metrics, audits, resources, scripts, images, fonts, and long tasks.
Ingests unorganized browser telemetry and standardizes units into precise milliseconds and unitless CLS scores, validating against strict contract schemas to guarantee downstream purity.
OUTPUT: ZyraEvidence Schema v1.0 · INVARIANT: Standardized units (ms), validated integrity
RULES — Applies deterministic thresholds and performance rules.
Executes 16 deterministic performance heuristics across Core Web Vitals, large bundles, render-blocking scripts, and image formats, assigning rigorous CRITICAL/HIGH/WARNING/INFO severities.
OUTPUT: Finding[] Schema v1.0 · INVARIANT: Zero LLM hallucinations, deterministic sorting
CODEBASE — Safely inspects framework, routes, imports, assets, configuration, and project structure.
Non-destructive AST scanner maps Next.js (App/Pages), Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Vite, and Angular workspaces, strictly excluding secrets (.env, keys) and rejecting symlink path escapes.
OUTPUT: CodebaseEvidence Schema v1.0 · INVARIANT: Read-only guarantee, zero script execution
CORRELATE — Connects browser evidence with relevant codebase evidence.
Strips bundler hash digests and traces runtime network requests and LCP elements directly to local source assets, dynamic route parameters, and component import graphs.
OUTPUT: CorrelationResult Schema v1.0 · INVARIANT: Transparent additive confidence weights
DIAGNOSE — Distinguishes observed facts, contributors, supported causes, and uncertainty.
Synthesizes causal attribution without speculating. If evidence is ambiguous, anomalies are explicitly marked UNKNOWN or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than inventing source lines.
OUTPUT: Structured Root-Cause Diagnosis Payload · INVARIANT: Explicit uncertainty boundaries
FIX — Creates constrained, safe, reversible fix plans.
Generates surgical modifications (lazy loading, defer scripts, font-display: swap) guarded by SHA-256 preflight content checks, dry-run simulation, and atomic transactional rollback.
OUTPUT: FixPlan & FixResult (Schema v1.0) · INVARIANT: Optimistic concurrency; aborts on PLAN_STALE
Executes a new performance test under identical device profiles, throttling profiles, and URL endpoints, supporting bounded repeated runs (1–5) to measure environmental variance.
OUTPUT: PostFix MeasurementSnapshot · INVARIANT: URL origin & device profile alignment
VERIFY — Determines improvement, regression, or inconclusive results.
Enforces APPLIED != IMPROVED. Verifies code state hashes, filters measurement noise (LCP 100ms, CLS 0.02, TBT 50ms), and makes objective KEEP_FIX or ROLLBACK_RECOMMENDED decisions.
OUTPUT: VerificationResult (Schema v1.0) · INVARIANT: Zero unverified performance gains
CI — Detects performance regressions deterministically in automation.
Gates pull requests against Web Vitals Good budgets (LCP 2500ms, CLS 0.10, INP 200ms) and compares to authoritative production baselines, returning stable exit codes (0–4).
INPUT: Staging Target URL + CIBaseline Snapshot
OUTPUT: CIResult (Schema v1.0) + PR Markdown · INVARIANT: Deterministic pipeline exit codes (0-4)
